text:
```yaml
name: Copilot SDK CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v3
      with:
        node-version: '24'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: make deps-copilot-client

    - name: Build project
      run: make copilot-client

    - name: Run tests
      run: make test-copilot-client

    - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
      uses: codecov/codecov-action@v3
      with:
        token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
        flags: unittests
        name: codecov-umbrella
        fail_ci_if_error: true
        verbose: true
```
